title: Improving Video Corpus Moment Retrieval with Partial Relevance Enhancement

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Improving Video Corpus Moment Retrieval with Partial Relevance Enhancement Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) is a new video retrieval task aimed at retrieving a relevant moment from a large corpus of untrimmed videos using a text query.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Action descriptions align more with visual elements, while character conversations are more related to textual information.Existing methods often treat all video contents equally, leading to sub-optimal moment retrieval.
